## Generated witnesses and complete truth

7 October 2026. [Ren renews pursuit of the stronger mathematical claim](../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-07-pursue-unique-mathematical-constitution.md). The [integrated investigation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ROOT-MATHEMATICAL-UNIVERSALITY-INTEGRATION.md) now connects independently specified witness formation to full truth in a declared language. Its two-module Lean package passes a fresh build with 43 named theorems and 84 declaration audits. Only the reported standard logical axioms occur; no proof hole or custom axiom is admitted.

The positive restricted case contains only equality in its interpreted language. A finite context is described by which entries agree. An additional witness can match an existing entry or introduce a fresh element. On the natural numbers, one more than an explicit upper bound for the tuple (zero for the empty tuple) supplies that fresh representative. The checked recursive Boolean evaluator examines these finitely many possibilities. Its correctness theorem covers every formula, including nested quantifiers and negation; its sentence result covers every carrier satisfying finite freshness. Zero and successor are construction rules in the background, not interpreted arithmetic symbols. This determines the whole equality-language theory without an arbitrary sentence-truth oracle; it does not decide arithmetic.

The general criterion is Tarski–Vaught witness adequacy: an embedding preserving functions and atomic relations preserves every first-order formula with internal parameters exactly when every ambient existential fact over those parameters has a witness in its image. Closing seeds under original operations and a fixed family of correct witness selectors produces an elementary hull. Its leastness is relative to those selected rules, not a uniquely least domain independent of selector choice. A proper doubling embedding of the natural numbers preserves all pure-equality formulas, illustrating that full truth preservation at the declared scope does not require retaining every ambient element.

The paired dependency test is exact. With two distinct closed named values, ask for the first value when a sentence holds and the second otherwise. An unrestricted correct selector returns the first exactly when the sentence is true. It therefore retains enough semantic information to recover every sentence truth; moving this selector into a primitive rule does not by itself explain that information. This does not make all witness mechanisms noncomputable. The restricted equality case demonstrates the kind of independently specified rule whose adequacy can instead be earned by proof.

**可独立说明的相等与新差异规则，能够决定明确范围内的全部真理；“为每个公式选择正确见证”则可能已把全部真值放进规则。** The constitutive proposal gains a concrete successful reduction and a substantive test of an apparent generalization. A matched structural account can still share every checked result while withholding ultimate generative priority. Universal coverage requires justified principles for richer languages, domains and interpretation; unique grounding additionally requires an account of why every adequate rival shares the same constitutive dependence. Neither follows solely from the theorem's universal quantification over formulas.

The next reduction must derive adequate witness operations from an independently specified structure, rather than supply their correctness for all formulas as an unexplained input. The mathematical background, finite contexts, semantics and freshness commitment remain explicit. Their local supplied status is not a claim that they inhabit a reality separate from generative unfolding. The stronger universal-and-exclusive objective remains open.
